increment_paragraph: **CALLBACK-SUPPLIED-NULL-ACTUAL (2026-11-19).** User decision 2026-11-19 launches the follow-up OPENSSL-UNSTATED-CALLBACK-SLOTS recorded. Gateway rule 13u amended in place (C04.19 item 2, grammar G05): the actual word supplied_nullable (CallbackActual::SuppliedNullable, beside Supplied and SuppliedOwned) is a value the callee supplies that may be NULL; it stands wherever `_` does and is a reserved parameter name. A candidate requiring resource_owned(nonnull) there is RequiresNonNullSupplied and refuses the call (callback-supplied-null); resource_borrowed and resource_owned(nullable) are admitted as at `_`; the position puts no requirement on the call, rule 13y matches it as `_`, rule 15w forwards it only to itself. Lean QCore.CallbackSuppliedNull (8 audited theorems: the refusal, an admitted candidate accepts NULL, marking never admits more, no nullable actual reads exactly as CallbackContracts.classifyModes, vectors bound to the Rust). quirin-provider-openssl marks, page-cited (documented::NULLABLE_ARGUMENTS; the checker refuses an uncited sentence or an entry no `_` reads): the security callback's s/ctx/other/ex (SSL_CTX_set_security_level 3.5), the PSK client hint and use-session md, and the BIO callbacks' argp/processed (BIO_set_callback); fetch_docs.py --argument-sentences records argument_null_sentences on three snapshots after refetching each at its recorded SHA-256. contracts.lock: the 10 re-stated declarations' digests change (the four handshake/I/O calls, SSL_shutdown, SSL_CTX_use_certificate(_chain_file), the PEM and PKCS#12 readers); no entry added; load path byte-identical. Opt-in current over Fluent Bit 046accf6 (main 062974679 vs tip): 1098 Safe / 2 Pending / 3699 Unknown / 5 Unsafe on both, 0 moves, 0 content changes, as predicted (no marked slot has a candidate). A supplementary run reading every plain `_` as nullable moved one row Safe to Unknown (librdkafka rd_kafka_ApiVersion_check: its bsearch comparator requires a live element, a false refusal) and changed three rows' content; the default stays (a user decision if it should change). Pinned routes read no user load path and no pinned module carries the word: no move predicted, measure --declared deferred to the integrator.

ledger.title: Callback arguments that are NULL when unset, which no page states
ledger.text: CALLBACK-SUPPLIED-NULL-ACTUAL marks a `_` actual supplied_nullable only on a page sentence. Left `_` (a candidate's resource_owned(nonnull) there is read as met): the user argument pointers a setter keeps and the slot hands back, NULL when the application set none (OpenSSL cert_cb arg, default_passwd_cb u, msg_callback arg, the ALPN/NPN/cert-verify/ClientHello/record-padding/early-data arg, the custom extensions' add_arg/parse_arg; librdkafka's rk_conf opaque); the custom extension callbacks' x outside Certificate messages; BIO method meth_ctrl's parg. A supplementary run reading every `_` as nullable showed the blanket default costs a correct Safe row (bsearch comparators). DISCHARGE: read the argument's nullability from the run's closed set of the setter's retained actuals (nullable unless every registration hands a non-null value), or mark each from a source that states it; Lean beside QCore.CallbackSuppliedNull. Size: medium.
